senses.en: Unable to find the way, or unable to be found.

senses.zh: bối rối; không biết phải làm sao
senses.en: Unable to understand something or decide what to do.
Past tense and past participle of lose.

ex.en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.

col: lost in thought｜chìm đắm trong suy nghĩ
tip: get lost nghĩa là bị lạc; khi dùng như câu mệnh lệnh (“Get lost!”) thì rất thô lỗ.

senses.en: The number equal to ten hundreds.
A very large quantity, expressed as thousands.

ex.en: The repair cost nearly a thousand dollars in total.
Several thousand residents have benefited from the new cycle routes connecting suburban neighbourhoods with the city centre.

tip: Sau số cụ thể không thêm s; nói hàng nghìn một cách chung chung dùng thousands of.

senses.en: The supreme being worshipped in religions believing in one god.

ex.en: My grandmother thanks God before each meal at home.
Belief in God can influence people's values, charitable activities, and responses to difficult circumstances.

col: faith in God｜đức tin vào Chúa
tip: Chỉ vị thần duy nhất thì viết God, thường không có mạo từ; thần nói chung viết god.

senses.en: Involving fewer hours than a full working or studying week.
For fewer hours than a full working or studying week.

ex.en: My sister has a part-time job at a bakery.
Part-time employment allows university students to gain practical experience while continuing to focus on their studies.

col: a part-time job｜một công việc bán thời gian
a part-time course｜khóa học bán thời gian
tip: Có thể là tính từ hoặc trạng từ: a part-time job; work part-time.

senses.en: Used to express that something is definitely true.
Used to agree politely to a request.

ex.en: This warm coat will certainly keep you comfortable outside.
Improved public transport would certainly benefit commuters, although its success would depend on reliable services and affordable fares.

col: will certainly help｜chắc chắn sẽ giúp ích
tip: Thường đứng trước động từ thường, sau be; cũng có thể đứng một mình để đáp lại lời đề nghị một cách lịch sự.

senses.en: The words someone knows or uses in a language.
The words used in a particular subject or activity.

ex.en: Reading short stories helps me build my English vocabulary.
Students need a broad academic vocabulary to understand lectures and express complex ideas clearly in essays.

col: expand your vocabulary｜mở rộng vốn từ
a limited vocabulary｜vốn từ hạn chế
tip: Một từ riêng lẻ là word; vocabulary chỉ tổng vốn từ hoặc tập hợp từ.

senses.en: A thin paper tube filled with tobacco for smoking.

ex.en: He refused a cigarette and went for a walk instead.
Higher cigarette taxes may discourage smoking, but accessible support services are also essential for people trying to quit.

col: a packet of cigarettes｜một bao thuốc lá
tip: Danh từ đếm được; một bao thuốc nói a packet of cigarettes.

senses.en: The possibility that someone or something will be harmed.
Someone or something that may cause harm.

ex.en: Keep away from the edge; there's a danger of falling.
Poorly maintained roads pose a serious danger to cyclists, particularly in areas without dedicated cycling lanes.

col: out of danger｜thoát khỏi nguy hiểm
pose a danger to｜gây nguy hiểm cho
danger of extinction｜nguy cơ tuyệt chủng
tip: in danger nghĩa là đang gặp nguy hiểm; dangerous là tính từ chỉ điều gây nguy hiểm.

senses.en: putting considerable effort and care into work

ex.en: Our hardworking neighbour grows vegetables for the whole street.
Even hardworking students may struggle academically without access to suitable learning resources and support.

tip: Là tính từ; muốn nói “làm việc chăm chỉ” dùng cụm động từ work hard.

senses.en: Located, used, or happening inside a building.

ex.en: Our hotel has an indoor pool beside the gym.
Indoor sports facilities allow children to remain physically active regardless of weather conditions throughout the year.

col: indoor swimming pool｜bể bơi trong nhà
indoor activities｜các hoạt động trong nhà
indoor air quality｜chất lượng không khí trong nhà
tip: indoor làm định ngữ; indoors là trạng từ, ví dụ stay indoors.

senses.en: Using, producing, or relating to electricity.
Full of excitement and energy.

ex.en: Our electric kettle boils water in two minutes.
Electric buses can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their power comes from renewable sources.

col: electric atmosphere｜bầu không khí sôi động
tip: Thiết bị chạy điện thường dùng electric; hệ thống điện thường dùng electrical.

senses.zh: giám đốc; người phụ trách; thành viên hội đồng quản trị
senses.en: Someone who manages an organisation, department, or company.
Someone who guides actors and controls a film or play.

ex.en: Our director welcomed the new staff at breakfast.
A museum director must balance the need to attract visitors with the responsibility to preserve valuable collections.

col: board of directors｜hội đồng quản trị
director of operations｜giám đốc vận hành
tip: Có thể chỉ người đứng đầu một tổ chức hoặc thành viên hội đồng quản trị, cũng có thể chỉ đạo diễn phim, kịch.

senses.en: Easy to use or suitable for your needs and plans.
Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.

ex.en: Is Saturday morning a convenient time for your visit?
Online learning offers a convenient way for working adults to develop skills without travelling to a campus.

col: a convenient time｜thời điểm thuận tiện
convenient for someone｜thuận tiện cho ai
a convenient location｜vị trí thuận tiện
a convenient way to｜một cách tiện lợi để
tip: Nói It is convenient for me, không nói I am convenient.

senses.zh: vào trung tâm thành phố; ở trung tâm thành phố
senses.en: in or towards the central business area of a city
located in the central business area of a city

senses.zh: khu trung tâm; khu thương mại
senses.en: the central business area of a city

ex.en: We took the bus downtown to buy new shoes.
Improved public transport can encourage more residents to shop downtown rather than drive to suburban shopping centres.

col: go downtown｜vào trung tâm thành phố
downtown shops｜cửa hàng ở trung tâm thành phố
tip: Chủ yếu dùng trong Anh-Mỹ; làm trạng từ thì không có to đứng trước.

senses.en: armed fighting between countries or groups
a determined effort to defeat something harmful

ex.en: The museum displays uniforms worn during the war.
War can disrupt children's education and force families to leave their homes in search of safety.

col: war on poverty｜cuộc chiến xóa đói giảm nghèo
tip: Đang trong tình trạng chiến tranh dùng at war, không có mạo từ.

senses.en: A person who reads, especially books, newspapers, or magazines
A device that displays written material or reads stored information

senses.zh: sách đọc theo cấp độ; sách giáo khoa đọc
senses.en: A book designed to help learners develop reading skills

ex.en: An eager reader, Lina always carries a book.
Digital libraries allow readers in remote communities to access educational resources without travelling to larger towns.

col: an avid reader｜người ham đọc sách
a graded reader｜sách đọc phân cấp
tip: reader có thể là người, thiết bị hoặc sách dùng để học đọc.

senses.zh: giáo dục; quá trình học tập
senses.en: The process of learning or teaching knowledge and skills.

ex.en: Her grandparents saved money to pay for her education.
Access to quality education can improve employment prospects and reduce inequality across different social groups.

col: access to education｜cơ hội tiếp cận giáo dục
tip: Thường không đếm được; nhưng có thể nói a good education (nền giáo dục tốt).

senses.en: a person's working life, often within a particular profession
to move very fast in a way that seems uncontrolled

ex.en: My sister hopes to build a career in nursing.
Access to affordable training enables adults to change career and adapt to a rapidly evolving labour market.

col: pursue a career｜theo đuổi một sự nghiệp
a career in teaching｜sự nghiệp giảng dạy
tip: career nhấn mạnh con đường nghề nghiệp lâu dài; job chỉ một công việc cụ thể.

senses.en: Unhappy because you lack companionship or close connections.
Far from people or rarely visited.

ex.en: I felt lonely until my neighbour invited me for tea.
Older adults may feel lonely after retirement, so community centres should provide regular opportunities for social interaction.

col: a lonely life｜một cuộc sống cô đơn
a lonely road｜một con đường vắng vẻ
tip: alone nhấn mạnh ở một mình; lonely nhấn mạnh cảm giác cô đơn trong lòng.

senses.en: A young dog.

ex.en: The puppy fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
Adopting a puppy requires a long-term commitment to training, exercise, and regular veterinary care.

col: a litter of puppies｜một ổ chó con
adopt a puppy｜nhận nuôi chó con
tip: Số nhiều là puppies; thường chỉ riêng chó con.

senses.en: A distinctive way of doing something or expressing ideas.
The design of something or a fashionable appearance.
To arrange or design something to achieve a particular look.

ex.en: Her colourful paintings have a cheerful, playful style.
Modern architects often adapt traditional building styles to preserve local identity while meeting contemporary housing needs.

tip: style có thể là phong cách cá nhân, không nhất thiết là thời trang.

senses.en: A food's flavour, or the sense that detects it.
To try food or drink, or have a particular flavour.
Someone's preferences or ability to judge what is attractive.

ex.en: The soup has a rich taste of roasted tomatoes.
Children may develop a taste for healthier foods when schools offer varied and appealing meals.

tip: taste nghĩa là “có vị” thì đi với tính từ, không đi với trạng từ.

senses.en: To push yourself off the ground into the air.
To increase suddenly by a large amount.
An act of jumping or a sudden large increase.

ex.en: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
Housing costs have jumped sharply in cities where demand continues to exceed the supply of affordable homes.

col: jump over a fence｜nhảy qua hàng rào
jump at the chance｜hăm hở nắm lấy cơ hội
a sharp jump in prices｜giá tăng vọt
tip: jump at the chance nghĩa là hăm hở nắm lấy cơ hội.

senses.en: Stored information about events, activities, or a person's history.

senses.zh: ghi lại; ghi âm; ghi hình
senses.en: To store information, sounds, or images for future use.
The best result ever achieved in a particular activity.

ex.en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
Accurate medical records allow healthcare professionals to make informed decisions and avoid unnecessary treatments.

col: record a conversation｜ghi âm cuộc trò chuyện
tip: Danh từ nhấn trọng âm ở âm tiết đầu; động từ nhấn ở âm tiết sau.

senses.en: A person who helps someone with their work.
Having a supporting role below the main person in charge.

ex.en: The assistant brought fresh towels into the treatment room.
Teaching assistants can provide additional support for children who need more individual attention in large classes.

tip: assistant chỉ người; assistance nghĩa là sự giúp đỡ, thường không đếm được.

senses.en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, or understand.
In a way that shows something is obviously true.

ex.en: Please speak clearly so everyone can hear you.
Public health information should clearly explain the benefits and potential risks of any recommended treatment.

tip: Clearly ở đầu câu thường nghĩa là “rõ ràng là”, không phải “một cách rõ ràng”.

senses.zh: thuộc Thụy Điển; thuộc tiếng Thụy Điển
senses.en: relating to Sweden, its people, or its language
the main language spoken in Sweden

ex.en: Our Swedish neighbour taught us to bake cinnamon buns.
Swedish cities offer useful examples of how urban planning can support cycling and reduce dependence on cars.

tip: Viết hoa chữ cái đầu; một người Thụy Điển là a Swede.

senses.en: A dish of vegetables or meat cooked with spices.
To cook food with curry spices.

ex.en: This vegetable curry tastes wonderful with rice and warm bread.
School cafeterias can offer vegetable curry as an affordable alternative to meals containing meat.

tip: curry thường chỉ món ăn; bột cà ri dùng curry powder.

senses.en: A trained person who cares for ill or injured people.
To care for someone who is ill or injured.

ex.en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
Employing more community nurses could improve access to healthcare for older people living in rural areas.

col: registered nurse｜y tá có chứng chỉ hành nghề
nurse someone back to health｜chăm sóc ai cho đến khi khỏe lại
tip: Làm động từ nurse đi thẳng với người: nurse a patient.

senses.zh: người hâm mộ; người đam mê
senses.en: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing
a device or object moved to create a cooling airflow
to move air towards something, or make a feeling stronger

ex.en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
Sports fans can strengthen local communities by supporting neighbourhood teams and participating in shared events.

col: a fan of｜người hâm mộ của
football fan｜cổ động viên bóng đá
fan the flames｜thổi bùng ngọn lửa
tip: Nói “người hâm mộ ...” dùng a fan of.

senses.en: a container used to hold flowers or for decoration

ex.en: I put fresh flowers in the vase by the window.
Traditional pottery, including decorative vases, can provide valuable insights into the artistic practices of past societies.

col: a vase of flowers｜một bình hoa
a glass vase｜bình hoa thủy tinh
tip: Anh-Anh thường đọc /vɑːz/; Anh-Mỹ thường đọc /veɪs/.

senses.en: a tool with a toothed blade for cutting hard materials
cut something using a saw
past tense of see: noticed or looked at something

ex.en: He used a saw to cut the wooden shelf.
The last decade saw significant improvements in public transport, particularly in rapidly growing urban areas.

col: saw through wood｜cưa xuyên qua gỗ
saw something in half｜cưa đôi vật gì
tip: Quá khứ của saw (cưa) là sawed; saw cũng là quá khứ của see.

senses.zh: huấn luyện viên; người đào tạo
senses.en: someone who teaches people or animals particular skills
a shoe designed for sport or casual wear

ex.en: My trainer showed me how to lift weights safely.
A qualified trainer can help employees develop practical skills that improve their performance at work.

col: personal trainer｜huấn luyện viên cá nhân
fitness trainer｜huấn luyện viên thể hình
a pair of trainers｜một đôi giày thể thao
tip: Giày thể thao trong Anh-Anh thường nói trainers, trong Anh-Mỹ thường nói sneakers.

senses.en: up to a particular time
up to the time when something happens

senses.zh: máy tính tiền; ngăn kéo đựng tiền
senses.en: a machine or drawer where a shop keeps cash

ex.en: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
Some parents work till late evening, making affordable childcare essential for families in urban areas.

col: at the till｜ở quầy thu ngân
tip: till có nghĩa như until; khi làm liên từ nói về tương lai thường theo sau là thì hiện tại đơn.

senses.en: No longer married because the marriage legally ended.
Separated from something that should be closely connected.

ex.en: My divorced uncle lives happily near his children.
Housing policies should consider the needs of divorced parents who share responsibility for raising children.

col: divorced from reality｜xa rời thực tế
tip: get divorced nghĩa là ly hôn; “tách rời khỏi điều gì” dùng divorced from.

senses.en: The idea that a word, action, or message communicates.
The importance or purpose that makes something worthwhile.

ex.en: Could you explain the meaning of this unusual word?
Volunteering can give people a sense of meaning while strengthening connections within their local communities.

col: the meaning of a word｜nghĩa của một từ
give meaning to life｜mang lại ý nghĩa cho cuộc sống
tip: Hỏi nghĩa của từ dùng the meaning of; đừng nhầm với opinion.

senses.en: Pasta shaped into long, thin strands.

ex.en: She twirled the spaghetti around her fork before taking a bite.
Simple meals such as spaghetti with vegetables can help students eat affordably while maintaining a balanced diet.

col: a plate of spaghetti｜một đĩa mì Ý
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; một đĩa dùng a plate of spaghetti.

senses.en: A plant whose strong-smelling bulbs are used to flavour food.

ex.en: Crush the garlic before adding it to the soup.
Using garlic and herbs can add flavour to meals without increasing their salt content.

col: a clove of garlic｜một tép tỏi
tip: Thường không đếm được; một tép tỏi dùng a clove of garlic.

senses.zh: sự kiểm soát; sự quản lý
senses.en: The power to direct or limit someone or something.

senses.zh: kiểm soát; quản lý; kiềm chế
senses.en: To direct, manage, or limit someone or something.
A device used to operate a machine or vehicle.

ex.en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
Stricter control of industrial emissions could improve air quality and reduce health risks in densely populated cities.

col: take control of｜nắm quyền kiểm soát
tip: Quá khứ controlled và hiện tại phân từ controlling đều gấp đôi chữ l.

senses.en: An international sporting competition with summer and winter editions.

ex.en: Our family watched the Olympics together after dinner.
Hosting the Olympics can improve transport infrastructure, but governments must consider the long-term costs of maintaining sports facilities.

col: host the Olympics｜đăng cai Thế vận hội
compete in the Olympics｜tham dự Thế vận hội
the Summer Olympics｜Thế vận hội mùa hè
the Winter Olympics｜Thế vận hội mùa đông
tip: Viết hoa chữ cái đầu, thường đi với the; cũng gọi là the Olympic Games.

senses.zh: bữa tối; bữa ăn nhẹ trước khi ngủ
senses.en: An evening meal, sometimes a light meal before bed.

ex.en: We had soup and fresh bread for supper.
Sharing supper regularly can help families maintain close relationships despite increasingly demanding work schedules.

tip: Thường chỉ bữa tối đơn giản hoặc bữa ăn nhẹ trước khi đi ngủ.

senses.en: causing harm or requiring careful attention
not joking, or thinking carefully about something

ex.en: The leaking pipe caused serious damage to our kitchen.
Air pollution remains a serious threat to public health, especially in densely populated cities.

col: take something seriously｜xem trọng việc gì
tip: serious about theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ, nghĩa là nghiêm túc với điều gì.

senses.en: physically pleasant and free from discomfort
feeling relaxed and confident in a situation
having enough money to live well without financial worry

ex.en: This soft chair is comfortable enough for an afternoon nap.
Comfortable classrooms with adequate lighting can help students concentrate and participate more actively in lessons.

col: comfortable with something｜thoải mái với điều gì
a comfortable income｜thu nhập dư dả
tip: comfortable chỉ sự dễ chịu; convenient chỉ sự thuận tiện.

senses.zh: năng động; tích cực tham gia
senses.en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part

senses.zh: đang hoạt động; có tác dụng
senses.en: currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

ex.en: My grandfather stays active by swimming every morning.
Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.

col: an active lifestyle｜lối sống năng động
play an active role｜đóng vai trò tích cực
tip: active chỉ sự năng động, tham gia tích cực; không giống positive (lạc quan, tích cực).

senses.zh: môn leo núi; leo vách đá
senses.en: The sport of going up rocks, mountains, or artificial walls.
Growing upwards by attaching to or winding around supports.

ex.en: I tried indoor climbing with my sister yesterday.
Schools can use supervised climbing activities to develop students' confidence, physical coordination, and ability to assess risks.

tip: Chữ b trong climb không đọc; climbing plants là cây leo.

senses.zh: chuyến tham quan; chuyến du lịch
senses.en: A journey visiting several places, or a guided visit somewhere.
A series of performances or matches held in different places.
To travel around places for sightseeing, performances, or other activities.

ex.en: We took a guided tour of the old castle.
Organized tours can introduce visitors to local traditions while providing reliable income for community guides.

col: guided tour｜chuyến tham quan có hướng dẫn viên
concert tour｜chuyến lưu diễn hòa nhạc
tip: tour nhấn mạnh việc tham quan hoặc hành trình nhiều điểm; trip là một chuyến đi nói chung.

senses.zh: căn hộ; căn hộ chung cư
senses.en: A set of rooms forming one home within a building.

ex.en: Our apartment has a small balcony overlooking the park.
Building affordable apartments near railway stations can reduce commuting costs for young workers.

tip: Anh-Mỹ thường dùng apartment; Anh-Anh thường dùng flat.

senses.en: surrounded by people or things
within or shared by a group

ex.en: We found a small wooden house among the trees.
Regular exercise is increasingly popular among office workers who spend most of their day sitting.

col: among other things｜trong số những thứ khác
tip: among nhấn mạnh trong một nhóm; between cũng dùng cho nhiều đối tượng khi nói rõ quan hệ giữa từng cái.

senses.en: Sliced bread browned and made crisp by heat.
To heat food until it becomes brown and crisp.

senses.zh: lời chúc rượu; lời nâng cốc
senses.en: An occasion when people raise drinks to honour someone or something.

ex.en: I spread butter on my toast while it was warm.
A simple breakfast of toast and fruit can help students maintain their energy during morning lessons.

col: a slice of toast｜một lát bánh mì nướng
propose a toast｜đề nghị nâng cốc
a toast to someone｜nâng cốc chúc mừng ai
tip: Khi chỉ bánh mì nướng thì không đếm được; một lời nâng cốc thì đếm được.

senses.en: A comfortable seat for two or more people.

senses.zh: diễn đạt; viết bằng lời lẽ
senses.en: To express something in a particular way.

ex.en: We curled up on the couch after dinner.
Public health advice should be couched in clear language so that everyone can understand it.

col: couched in diplomatic terms｜diễn đạt bằng ngôn từ ngoại giao
tip: Động từ thường dùng be couched in, nghĩa là được diễn đạt bằng cách nói nào đó.

senses.en: an area of land used for crops or farm animals
a particular area of study or work
an area of ground used for playing a sport

ex.en: We watched sheep grazing in the field behind our cottage.
Research in the field of renewable energy could create employment opportunities and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.

col: a wheat field｜cánh đồng lúa mì
in the field of｜trong lĩnh vực
tip: Khi nói về lĩnh vực nghiên cứu hoặc công việc thường dùng in the field of.

senses.zh: trực tuyến; có kết nối mạng
senses.en: Available through the internet or connected to a computer network.
Using the internet or while connected to a computer network.

ex.en: I booked our train tickets online after dinner.
Online courses can widen access to education, especially for learners who live far from universities.

tip: Có thể là tính từ hoặc trạng từ: shop online.

senses.en: A comfortable chair with supports for your arms.

senses.zh: chỉ nói suông; thiếu kinh nghiệm thực tế
senses.en: Giving opinions without direct experience or active involvement.

ex.en: Grandpa fell asleep in his armchair beside the window.
Armchair critics may underestimate the practical challenges that teachers face when managing large classes with limited resources.

col: sit in an armchair｜ngồi trên ghế bành
armchair critic｜nhà phê bình chỉ biết nói suông
tip: Ngồi trong ghế bành dùng in; khi là tính từ đứng trước danh từ, thường mang nghĩa chê.

senses.en: someone who plays music, especially professionally

ex.en: A musician played the violin outside the station.
Local musicians can strengthen community identity by performing traditional songs at public festivals and cultural events.

tip: musician chỉ người làm âm nhạc; nhà soạn nhạc cụ thể hơn là composer.

senses.en: from a past time until a later time, usually now
from when something happened; because something is true
at a time or throughout the period after that

ex.en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
Since public transport reduces traffic congestion, governments should invest in more reliable bus services.

tip: Khi chỉ thời gian, since đi với mốc bắt đầu, for đi với khoảng thời gian.

senses.en: a building where Christians gather to worship
Christian religious worship attended as a service
an organized group of Christians sharing beliefs and practices

ex.en: The old church has beautiful windows and a stone tower.
Preserving a historic church can protect local heritage while providing opportunities for education and tourism.

col: go to church｜đi lễ nhà thờ
tip: go to church nghĩa là đi lễ; go to the church nghĩa là đi đến tòa nhà nhà thờ.

senses.zh: lính cứu hỏa; người chữa cháy
senses.en: A person trained to put out fires and rescue people

ex.en: The firefighter showed us how to use the hose.
Every firefighter requires regular training to respond safely and effectively to emergencies in increasingly complex urban environments.

col: a trained firefighter｜lính cứu hỏa được đào tạo
a volunteer firefighter｜lính cứu hỏa tình nguyện
firefighter training｜đào tạo lính cứu hỏa
tip: firefighter không phân biệt giới tính, thông dụng hơn fireman.

senses.en: A grand official home for a royal or important leader.

ex.en: We walked through the palace gardens before lunch.
Opening a historic palace to visitors can generate income for conservation and support local tourism.

tip: Chủ yếu là danh từ; palace cũng có thể đứng trước danh từ khác, ví dụ palace gardens.

senses.en: A structure carrying people or vehicles over an obstacle.
To connect separated things or reduce differences between them.
A card game played by four people in two partnerships.

ex.en: We crossed the wooden bridge and entered the village.
Community language programmes can bridge cultural differences and help newcomers participate more fully in local life.

col: bridge the gap｜thu hẹp khoảng cách
tip: bridge the gap thường nghĩa là thu hẹp khoảng cách giữa các nhóm hoặc sự việc.

senses.zh: sự ăn uống; chế độ ăn
senses.en: the activity of taking food into your body

senses.zh: đang ăn (hiện tại phân từ của eat)
senses.en: taking food into your mouth and swallowing it

ex.en: Healthy eating starts with small changes to your meals.
Schools can encourage healthy eating by providing balanced lunches and teaching children how to prepare simple meals.

tip: eating có thể làm danh động từ; eat out nghĩa là ăn ngoài.

senses.en: a useful piece of advice
the narrow or pointed end of something
extra money given to someone for providing a service

ex.en: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
Schools can offer practical tips on managing money to help young people develop responsible spending habits.

col: a useful tip｜một mẹo hữu ích
the tip of the tongue｜đầu lưỡi
leave a tip｜để lại tiền boa
tip: Khi nghĩa là “lời khuyên” thì tip đếm được, còn advice thì không: a tip.

senses.en: Practical use of scientific knowledge, especially through tools and machines.

ex.en: New technology lets us control the lights from our phones.
Investment in clean technology can reduce industrial pollution while creating skilled jobs in emerging sectors.

col: develop new technologies｜phát triển các công nghệ mới
tip: Khi nói chung thì không đếm được; nhiều công nghệ cụ thể dùng technologies.

senses.en: A narrow track for people to walk along.
The route along which someone or something moves.
A way of achieving something or developing over time.

ex.en: We followed a narrow path down to the beach.
Access to affordable education can provide a path out of poverty for disadvantaged communities.

col: follow a path｜đi theo lối mòn
a path to success｜con đường dẫn đến thành công
tip: Con đường để đạt được mục tiêu dùng a path to, theo sau to là danh từ.

senses.en: A set of connected parts that work together.
An organised structure through which services or institutions operate.
An organised way of doing something.

ex.en: The heating system stopped working during a cold night.
An effective education system should support students with different abilities and prepare them for future employment.

col: public transport system｜hệ thống giao thông công cộng
tip: systematic nghĩa là có hệ thống, bài bản; systemic nghĩa là thuộc toàn hệ thống.

senses.zh: phía đông bắc; vùng đông bắc
senses.en: The direction between north and east, or an area's northeastern part.

senses.zh: thuộc đông bắc; từ đông bắc
senses.en: Located in, facing, or coming from the northeast.

senses.zh: về phía đông bắc; ở phía đông bắc
senses.en: Towards or in the direction between north and east.

ex.en: The storm is moving northeast towards the coastal villages.
Investment in rail connections could improve access to employment for communities in the northeast of the country.

col: in the northeast｜ở vùng đông bắc
head northeast｜đi về hướng đông bắc
the northeast coast｜bờ biển đông bắc
tip: northeast of nghĩa là ở phía đông bắc của đâu đó; Anh-Anh cũng viết north-east.

senses.en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre.

ex.en: This little plant grew one centimetre in a week.
Even a small rise in sea level, measured in centimetres, can increase flooding risks in coastal communities.

tip: Anh-Anh viết centimetre, Anh-Mỹ viết centimeter; viết tắt là cm.

senses.en: the scientific study of living things

senses.zh: đặc điểm sinh học; cơ chế sinh lý
senses.en: the natural processes and characteristics of a living thing

ex.en: We examined onion cells under microscopes in biology today.
A basic understanding of biology helps people evaluate health information and make informed decisions about their lifestyles.

col: human biology｜sinh học cơ thể người
tip: Tên môn học thường không đếm được; nhà sinh học là biologist.

senses.en: Someone who creates pictures using paint.
Someone whose job is painting buildings or other surfaces.

ex.en: The painter mixed blue and green on her palette.
Local painters can preserve cultural traditions while introducing younger audiences to new artistic styles.

col: a landscape painter｜họa sĩ vẽ phong cảnh
a portrait painter｜họa sĩ vẽ chân dung
tip: Có thể chỉ họa sĩ nghệ thuật hoặc người sơn tường.

senses.en: A thin rubber bag filled with air or gas.
A large gas-filled bag carrying people in a basket.

ex.en: A yellow balloon floated above the birthday cake.
Releasing balloons outdoors can harm wildlife when the rubber fragments fall into rivers and oceans.

col: blow up a balloon｜thổi bóng bay
tip: blow up a balloon nghĩa là thổi phồng quả bóng bay, không phải làm nổ bóng.

senses.en: Achieving the result that was wanted or intended.
Having achieved wealth, respect, or a good position.

ex.en: Our first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
Successful recycling programmes depend on convenient collection facilities and clear guidance for households and businesses.

col: successful in doing something｜thành công trong việc làm gì
tip: Thường dùng be successful in doing; động từ tương ứng là succeed.

senses.zh: chủ đề; đề tài; môn học
senses.en: Something discussed, studied, or taught.

senses.zh: phụ thuộc vào; chịu sự chi phối của
senses.en: Affected by something or dependent on a condition.

senses.zh: bắt chịu; làm cho trải qua
senses.en: To make someone experience something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
Schools should give creative subjects sufficient attention because they help students develop imagination and problem-solving skills.

col: subject to approval｜tùy thuộc vào sự phê duyệt
subject someone to stress｜khiến ai chịu căng thẳng
tip: Động từ nhấn trọng âm ở âm tiết sau: /səbˈdʒekt/; thường dùng subject A to B.

senses.en: very unreasonable, foolish, or strange
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something
extremely annoyed or upset

ex.en: It seems crazy to wear sandals in this snow.
Although some people consider car-free cities a crazy idea, such policies could significantly improve urban air quality.

col: drive someone crazy｜làm ai phát điên
a crazy idea｜ý tưởng điên rồ
tip: Mang tính khẩu ngữ; crazy about nghĩa là mê mẩn, không nên dùng để gọi người mắc bệnh tâm thần.

senses.en: Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship.
Two things or people, or a small number of them.
To join two things or consider them together.

ex.en: The couple next door invited us over for dinner.
High housing costs, coupled with limited childcare, can discourage young couples from starting a family.

col: a married couple｜một cặp vợ chồng
tip: a couple of theo sau là danh từ số nhiều, có thể là hai hoặc vài.

senses.en: Feeling afraid of something or worried that something bad might happen.

ex.en: The puppy looked scared when it heard the thunder.
Students who are scared of making mistakes may avoid speaking during foreign language lessons.

tip: scared diễn tả người cảm thấy sợ; scary diễn tả điều gây sợ.

senses.en: below something else in position, level, or amount
to move something down or reduce its level

ex.en: Keep the heavy bowls on the lower shelf.
Governments can lower transport costs by investing in reliable bus services and safe cycling routes.

tip: Làm động từ thường có tân ngữ; với giá cả giảm xuống có thể dùng không có tân ngữ.

senses.en: a small, flat piece of metal used as money

senses.zh: đặt ra (từ mới, cách nói mới)
senses.en: to invent a new word or expression

ex.en: A silver coin rolled under the kitchen table.
As digital payments become more widespread, fewer consumers carry coins for everyday purchases such as bus fares.

col: coin a term｜đặt ra một thuật ngữ
tip: Động từ coin thường nghĩa là tạo ra một từ ngữ mới, ví dụ coin a term.

senses.zh: kỹ năng; kỹ thuật; tài năng
senses.en: an ability to do something well, developed through practice

ex.en: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.

col: develop a skill｜phát triển một kỹ năng
skill in doing something｜kỹ năng làm gì
tip: Kỹ năng cụ thể thì đếm được; nói chung về sự thành thạo thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: A lightweight frame flown in the wind on a string
A bird of prey with long wings and often a forked tail

ex.en: We flew a bright kite on the windy beach.
Outdoor activities such as flying kites offer families affordable recreation and encourage children to spend time away from screens.

tip: “Thả diều” nói fly a kite, không nói play a kite.

senses.en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem.
A particular thing that someone does.

senses.zh: cảnh hành động; tình tiết kịch tính
senses.en: Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.

ex.en: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
Governments must take urgent action to protect coastal communities from the growing risks of climate change.

col: course of action｜phương án hành động
tip: Trong take action, action không đếm được; hành động cụ thể có thể dùng actions.

senses.zh: đã xây dựng; đã dựng (quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ của build)
senses.en: past tense and past participle of build
having a particular body shape or physical build

ex.en: We built a small shelter for the garden tools.
New homes should be built near public transport to reduce residents' dependence on private cars.

col: built to last｜được làm để bền lâu
well built｜vóc dáng khỏe mạnh; xây chắc chắn
purpose-built facilities｜cơ sở vật chất xây dựng chuyên dụng
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ của build đều là built, không phải builded.

senses.en: to be determined or affected by something
to need or trust someone or something for support

ex.en: Our weekend plans depend on how the weather turns out.
Many rural communities depend on reliable public transport to access healthcare, education, and employment opportunities.

col: depend heavily on｜phụ thuộc nhiều vào
depend on someone to do something｜trông cậy vào ai làm gì
tip: Thường đi với on hoặc upon; It depends nghĩa là “còn tùy”.

senses.en: The middle of the day, around twelve o'clock.

ex.en: We stopped for lunch at mid-day beside the river.
Outdoor workers should have access to shade at mid-day, when exposure to direct sunlight can be intense.

tip: Ngày nay thường viết là midday; vào giữa trưa dùng at midday.
note: Biến thể có gạch nối vẫn dùng được; ngày nay thường viết là midday.

senses.en: Something said or done to make people laugh.
To say something funny or not seriously meant.

ex.en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
Teachers sometimes use jokes to reduce anxiety and create a more relaxed classroom atmosphere.

col: play a joke on someone｜chơi khăm ai
joke about something｜đùa về điều gì
tip: Kể chuyện cười dùng tell a joke, không dùng say a joke.

senses.en: Someone invited to visit a home or attend an event.
Someone staying at a hotel or similar accommodation.

ex.en: Each guest brought a dish to share at dinner.
Hotels can encourage guests to conserve water by offering towel replacement only when requested.

tip: guest có thể là khách được mời hoặc khách trả tiền ở khách sạn.

senses.en: A surface on which electronic images or films appear.
To check people or things for problems or suitability.
To show a film or programme to an audience.

ex.en: I wiped the fingerprints off my laptop screen.
Health services should screen vulnerable patients regularly to detect diseases before serious symptoms develop.

col: screen time｜thời gian dùng màn hình
tip: screen A for B nghĩa là kiểm tra A xem có vấn đề B hay không.

senses.en: a machine that washes dishes and kitchen utensils
a person employed to wash dishes

ex.en: Please load the dishwasher after you finish your lunch.
Running a dishwasher only when it is full can help households conserve water and energy.

col: load the dishwasher｜xếp bát đĩa vào máy rửa bát
unload the dishwasher｜lấy bát đĩa ra khỏi máy rửa bát
dishwasher detergent｜nước rửa chuyên dụng cho máy rửa bát
tip: Trong đời sống thường chỉ máy rửa bát; trong tuyển dụng cũng có thể chỉ người rửa bát.

senses.en: In every way or to the fullest possible degree.

ex.en: My shoes were completely wet after walking through the rain.
Although online courses offer flexibility, they cannot completely replace the social benefits of classroom learning.

tip: Chỉ mức độ trọn vẹn, thường bổ nghĩa cho tính từ hoặc động từ.

senses.zh: người cộng tác; đối tác; thành viên góp vốn
senses.en: Someone you work, play, or share a business with.
Someone you share a romantic relationship or married life with.

senses.zh: hợp tác với; kết hợp với
senses.en: Work or take part in an activity with someone.

ex.en: My dance partner waited patiently while I practised.
Universities can partner with local businesses to offer students practical experience before they enter the workforce.

tip: partner không nêu rõ giới tính; làm động từ thường dùng partner with.

senses.en: A sport involving hitting a shuttlecock over a net with rackets

ex.en: We play badminton at the sports centre every Saturday.
Schools can encourage regular exercise by offering accessible activities such as badminton and swimming.

tip: Tên môn thể thao thường không đếm được; “chơi cầu lông” dùng play badminton.

senses.en: not a single person
a person considered unimportant or unknown

ex.en: Nobody noticed the kitten sleeping behind the sofa.
Nobody should be denied access to education because their family cannot afford school fees.

tip: Làm chủ ngữ thì động từ dùng số ít; bản thân từ này đã mang nghĩa phủ định.

senses.en: the land along the edge of the sea
to move without using power or much effort

senses.zh: làm việc nhàn nhã mà vẫn thành công
senses.en: to succeed or progress without trying very hard

ex.en: We walked along the coast and collected smooth stones.
Communities along the coast face increasing risks from rising sea levels and severe storms.

col: along the coast｜dọc theo bờ biển
tip: on the coast nghĩa là ở ven biển; off the coast nghĩa là ở ngoài khơi gần bờ.

senses.en: To go or come into a place.
To become involved in a competition, activity, or organisation.
To put information into a computer or official record.

ex.en: Please wipe your shoes before you enter the kitchen.
Young people often need practical training before they enter the workforce and take on professional responsibilities.

col: enter a competition｜tham gia cuộc thi
enter the workforce｜bước vào thị trường lao động
tip: Vào một nơi dùng enter a place, không thêm into.

senses.en: A large fortified building with thick walls and towers.

ex.en: We climbed the hill to explore the old castle.
Restoring a historic castle can attract tourists while preserving valuable evidence of a region's architectural heritage.

col: medieval castle｜lâu đài thời trung cổ
castle walls｜tường thành của lâu đài
tip: Chữ t trong castle không đọc; palace chỉ cung điện.

senses.en: Extremely bad or unpleasant.

ex.en: The soup tasted awful, so I made a sandwich.
Residents described the awful conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter safety standards.

col: feel awful｜cảm thấy rất khó chịu
tip: feel awful có thể chỉ khó chịu trong người, cũng có thể là cảm thấy có lỗi hoặc tâm trạng tồi tệ.

senses.en: Written words, especially the main written content of something.
A short written message sent using a phone.
Send someone a short written message using a phone.

ex.en: The text on this menu is too small.
Teachers can combine text with images to help students understand complex scientific concepts more easily.

tip: Nội dung chữ thường không đếm được; một tin nhắn dùng a text.

senses.en: something that happens because of an action or event

senses.zh: điểm số; kết quả (thi, thi đấu)
senses.en: the final score or outcome of a test or competition
to happen because of something or cause something to happen

ex.en: The shiny floor was the result of hours of cleaning.
Investing in reliable public transport can result in lower emissions and shorter commuting times for urban residents.

tip: result in theo sau là kết quả; result from theo sau là nguyên nhân.

senses.en: A large container that you sit in to wash your body.

ex.en: The kitten watched water dripping into the empty bathtub.
Replacing a bathtub with a shower can save space in small urban apartments.

col: fill the bathtub｜xả đầy bồn tắm
a freestanding bathtub｜bồn tắm độc lập
tip: bathtub thường dùng trong Anh-Mỹ; Anh-Anh thường nói bath.

senses.en: A box where letters are delivered or collected.
An electronic space where email messages are received and stored.

ex.en: A postcard from my cousin arrived in our mailbox.
Residents in remote areas may travel considerable distances to reach the nearest public mailbox.

col: check your mailbox｜kiểm tra hộp thư
an overflowing mailbox｜hộp thư đầy ắp
an electronic mailbox｜hộp thư điện tử
tip: Thường dùng trong Anh-Mỹ; Anh-Anh thường dùng letterbox hoặc postbox.

senses.en: something you do regularly, often without thinking

ex.en: Checking my phone before breakfast has become a habit.
Developing the habit of regular exercise during childhood can improve health throughout adult life.

col: form a habit｜hình thành thói quen
get into the habit of｜tập thành thói quen
tip: Thói quen làm gì dùng habit of doing.

senses.en: The hard natural material forming much of Earth's surface.
Popular music with a strong beat, often featuring electric guitars.
Move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

ex.en: We sat on a flat rock beside the river.
Studying ancient rock layers helps scientists understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.

col: rock formation｜cấu tạo đá; địa tầng
rock a baby｜đưa nôi nhẹ nhàng cho em bé
tip: Khi là vật liệu đá thì không đếm được; một hòn đá thì đếm được.
